source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Hybrid marksman whose abilities evolve as she buys stats, isolating targets with Q and diving with R onto plasma-marked champions. Weak early, she scales into a mobile assassin-carry.
strengths: Q deals all missiles to an isolated target
R dashes to any plasma-marked champion, with a shield
W is a long-range poke that reveals and stacks plasma
weaknesses: Short attack range for a marksman

curve.lvl6: strong – R follow-up on support CC

profile.curveNote: Trades with Q on isolated targets; spikes on evolutions.
profile.mobility: high – R dash, E move speed

Q.notes: Missiles split among nearby enemies; stand in minions to absorb them.

W.notes: Long-range blast stops at first hit; reveals and stacks plasma.

E.notes: Charge for speed (ghosted), then attack speed; evolved grants brief invisibility.

R.notes: Dash near a plasma-marked champion, gain a shield.

Passive.notes: Attacks stack plasma; ally immobilizing CC stacks it too.

profile.windowAgainst: Early levels before evolutions and when R is down: trade in minions to dodge Q.
